event: US and Israeli airstrikes on Iranian military targets begin the war; Hormuz traffic largely blocked from this date
notes: Brief said 'late February' - pinned to 28 Feb

event: IRGC formally declares the Strait of Hormuz closed to 'unfriendly nations'; only Iran-approved vessels may pass
notes: Primary closure date; Brent peaked near $118-120 in the weeks after

event: IRGC claims the Iranian navy has achieved 'complete control' of the strait
Pakistan-brokered ceasefire allows limited reopening of the strait
notes: Date from secondary coverage; confirm against a primary source before using in the event study

event: US naval blockade of Iranian ports begins
Iran re-closes the strait, citing the US port blockade as a ceasefire breach
notes: SOURCES CONFLICT: reported as both 18 and 19 April. Test event-study robustness to both.

event: US naval blockade of Iranian ports ends
US-Iran memorandum of understanding signed to open Hormuz to commercial shipping; collapses within weeks over permitted routes
Strait effectively closed again in early July; Gulf loadings fall from ~20 mb/d to ~12 mb/d over the month
notes: IEA dates this to 'early July' without a day. 1 July is a placeholder - do not read the event-study day-0 too literally.

event: IEA cuts its 2026 oil demand forecast on Hormuz disruption; regional exports down 2.1 mb/d to 15 mb/d
notes: Scheduled release, not a shock - useful as a placebo event

event: Drone strikes launched from Iraq hit Saudi Arabia's East-West (Petroline) crude pipeline
notes: Attack reported over 10-11 Sept; ~4 mb/d of Hormuz-bypass capacity threatened

event: Saudi Arabia shuts the East-West pipeline; repairs estimated at weeks. Brent moves above $108
notes: Closes the main route for crude to bypass Hormuz - watch Yanbu vs Ras Tanura port calls

event: Oman postpones the Iran-GCC Hormuz talks that were to be held 14 Sept in Salalah
